channel.ownership: userId matches account OR profileId captured; require both to agree
channel.included: id, name, description, profileId, communityId/slug, policy, app scope, counts, public flag, timezone, banner/avatar references, timestamps

video.ownership: joined owned channel, optional community must agree; pending/processing fails capture
video.included: id, full supported title/description, typed legacy/source/playback/HLS/thumbnail Asset references, channel/community, duration/resolution/encoding, processingStatus, counts, visibility, timestamps

channelSubscription.ownership: actor userId OR captured profileId; both must agree

videoView.ownership: actor userId OR captured profileId; every present identity must agree, including personal views of foreign videos
videoView.included: id, opaque target videoId, watchDurationSeconds, viewedAt

channelFeed.ownership: joined owned channel; community must agree
channelFeed.included: id, channel/community, timezone, currentMode, active program/live/video opaque references and timestamps

programBlock.ownership: joined owned channel; community must agree
programBlock.included: id, channel/community/video references, blockType, supported full title/description, status, scheduling/actual timestamps

liveSession.ownership: joined owned channel OR account-created; partial creator identity match fails; attached community must agree
liveSession.included: id, community/channel, supported title/description, status, start/end/created/update timestamps, thumbnail Asset reference; creator IDs only for own-created records

notEstablished: Authenticated media ownership/existence/version consistency for referenced Asset IDs
Snapshot RPC, Authentication job registration or final artifact
